title: fix: windows are clipped in overview mode causing visual artifact
body:
If you hold super and drag a window (overview mode) all the windows other than the grabbed window will shrink to the top left corner of their region clipping the right and bottom part of those windows. Causing the SSDs to stick out too. This should fix that.

before:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bdd1752b-80a8-421d-b28e-e32bf6341684

after:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e6b19530-4cf6-4bd1-adfd-d155520de455

files.patch:
@@ -5563,11 +5563,18 @@ where
                 let elem_geometry = mapped.geometry().to_physical_precise_round(output_scale);
 
                 let scale = geo.size.to_f64() / original_geo.size.to_f64();
+                // In overview mode, don't pass max_size to avoid pre-clipping.
+                // Let constrain_render_elements handle scaling instead.
+                let max_size = if is_overview {
+                    None
+                } else {
+                    Some(geo.size.as_logical())
+                };
                 let shadow_element = mapped.shadow_render_element(
                     renderer,
                     geo.loc.as_logical().to_physical_precise_round(output_scale)
                         - elem_geometry.loc,
-                    Some(geo.size.as_logical()),
+                    max_size,
                     Scale::from(output_scale),
                     scale.x.min(scale.y),
                     alpha,
